Central Virginia Horse Rescue, Inc (CVHR) is a  501(c)3 non-profit organization dedicated to the compassionate care of equines.  Our mission is to save, protect, and rehabilitate equines in need.  We rescue unwanted, abused, neglected, or abandoned equines; provide them with care and rehabilitation; and finally find them a compatible, loving home.  We believe that education is the long-term solution to improving the lives of equines.

Our goal is to aid abused, neglected, starving, and unwanted horses from surrenders, animal control, or auctions. We provide food, training, and veterinary care for their recovery. Post-recovery, they're evaluated and put up for adoption to approved homes. Economic challenges have led to increased horse sales but fewer buyers, resulting in more horses in danger. Many are abandoned or auctioned. We offer these horses a temporary haven until a permanent, loving home is found.
